# CXO Ecosystem Index

Independent structured index maintained by Open Future Forum. Inclusion does not imply endorsement.

Maps: CXO roles; organizations; provider types; communities and networks; membership formats; event formats; research and benchmarks; decision resources; executive needs; leadership topics; and geographies.

Canonical resources:
- Entities: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/entities.json
- Taxonomy: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/taxonomy.json
- Statistics: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/statistics.json
- v0.5.0 report: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/v050-report.html
- Methodology: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/methodology.html
- Repository: https://github.com/OpenFutureForum/cxo-ecosystem-index

Entity associations require evidence. Filter combinations are not canonical pages. Coverage is representative at dataset version 0.5.0.
